title: Northern Lights Money-Back Guarantee
location: Nordic countries, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Iceland, Faroe Islands, Greenland, Finland, Estonia, Lithuania, Latvia, Svalbard
description:
We have just launched Aurora Highlights in Autumn, a 7-day independent journey from Finnish Lapland to Arctic Norway, available September 1 through October 27, 2026. Every booking includes a Northern Lights Money-Back Guarantee: if no northern lights are seen at either destination during your client's stay, they receive a fixed partial refund on their accommodation costs.

**Why this sells**
One of the first formal northern lights money-back guarantees offered by a Nordic specialist
Peak aurora season without deep winter cold, easier to sell to hesitant clients
Compact 7-day itinerary, easy to add to broader European plans via Helsinki 
Strong solar cycle makes 2026 an exceptional year to be pushing aurora travel

**Why fall works**
September and October are historically among the strongest aurora months of the year
For travelers familiar with fall foliage, the Nordic version has its own character: birch and rowan forests turning gold and amber above the Arctic Circle, arriving earlier and more intensely than anything further south
The northern lights appearing above that landscape is something winter simply cannot offer
Temperatures are cool but nothing like midwinter, no extreme cold gear required

As Mari, our CEO, put it: 
You don't need minus 20 degrees to see the northern lights. Some of our most spectacular sightings happen in September, in temperatures closer to a crisp fall evening in Minneapolis or Vancouver. The guarantee is our way of giving travelers confidence to try fall.

title: Explore Alila Hotels & Resorts of Bali!
From Ocean Breeze to Desert Soul: A Moroccan Odyssey
description:
Embark on a journey that captures the essence of Morocco, a land where every landscape tells a story and every encounter stirs the heart.
Your odyssey begins by the Atlantic’s cool embrace in Casablanca, where modern elegance meets timeless charm. Travel north along the coast to Larache and Tangier, where the sea whispers tales of ancient traders and poets gazing toward Spain across the Strait of Gibraltar.
Venture inland to the Blue Pearl of Chefchaouen, a serene haven of painted alleys and mountain air, before continuing to the spiritual capital of Fes, where tradition breathes through labyrinthine medinas and master artisans keep centuries-old crafts alive.
Your path then leads south through the changing colors of Morocco, from the ochre tones of Marrakech, alive with its vibrant souks and secret gardens, to the tranquil peaks of the High Atlas Mountains, where life unfolds at a gentler pace.
The journey culminates in the vast stillness of the Agafay Rocky Desert, where silence meets the stars, and the spirit of Morocco reveals itself in its purest form, soulful, timeless, and deeply human.
A symphony of contrasts and emotions, “From Ocean Breeze to Desert Soul: A Moroccan Odyssey” is not just an itinerary, it is an awakening of the senses and a celebration of Morocco’s enduring beauty.

description:

Plan and book your holiday early. Save up to 10% off your stay at Banyan Tree Samui when you book in advance.

• Book period : 03 November 2020 – 31 December 2026
• Stay Period : 03 November 2020 – 31 December 2026

• Book now at https://www.banyantree.com/en/thailand/samui or contact us at reservations-samui@banyatree.com

General Terms and Conditions

• Rates are quoted in Thai Baht (THB) on a per villa per night basis.
• Rates are inclusive of 10% Service Charge and 8.7% Government Tax.
• Check-in time is 1500 hours and Check-out time is 1200 hours.
• Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability.
• Late check-out from 1200 hours to 1800 hours will be charged 50% of the Best Available Rate of the day.
• Late check-out from 1800 hours will be charged 100% of the Best Available Rate of the day.
• In the event of a no-show or early departure, the total rate of the confirmed room nights for the entire stay shall be chargeable.
• Credit card information provided does not require a signature and constitutes approval by the cardholder to guarantee the booking as per our cancellation policies. Additionally, scanned passport details of the card holder are required. Third person credit card details are not permitted to guarantee bookings.
• Reservations will be cancelled at the resort’s discretion without prior notice should an invalid credit card be submitted.
• Extra person charge with breakfast is THB 7,500 per person per night, inclusive of service charge and prevailing taxes.
• No pets are allowed.

Guarantee Policy

• Original credit card used during booking must be presented at the time of check-in
• Note: All add-on services selected during the booking process is not included in the "Payment Details" and will be chargeable upon check-in at the Resort.
• Reservation requires full prepayment.

Cancellation Policy

• Free cancellation up to 21 days (90days for peak dates) prior to arrival.
• Cancellations made within 21 days prior to arrival will be subject to a charge of 100% of the entire stay.

Rebooking Policy

• Rebooking is allowed up to 14 days prior to arrival. Rebooking could incur difference in rates based on the new dates selected.

Child Policy

• Infants and toddlers, who are below 4 years, accompanying adults, dine and stay in existing bedding or a baby cot with our compliments. Baby cot is subject to availability.
• Children 4 to 12 years, accompanying adults, can stay on existing bedding with our compliments and dine at 50% off regular menu prices, except for kid’s menu. Extra bed may be reserved with compliments, subject to availability.

Other Information

• Airport transfer is available at THB 2,500 nett per vehicle per way for a Mercedes Benz E350 with a maximum of 2 passengers or at THB 2,000 nett per vehicle per way for a Luxury Van with a maximum of 5 passengers. Rate is inclusive of service charge and prevailing taxes.
• Due to the unique architectural style of Banyan Tree Samui, it is not recommended for families with children below 12 years of age. Permitting children to stay in the villas will be at the discretion of parents who must fill out a Liability Disclaimer Form provided by the resort.

title: Complimentary Hotel Night in Paris at Le Meurice when booking Les Bateaux Belmond
description:
Charter one of Les Bateaux Belmond's 7 bateaux in the wine regions of France this July or August 2026 and receive a complimentary overnight stay in Paris, either the night before or after your journey.

The Les Bateaux Belmond fleet in France is made up of seven beautifully intimate boats that float through the wine regions of France. Each vessel has just 2–7 cabins, accommodating between 4 and 12 guests, which makes the experience feel incredibly private. That said, what really sets this apart is the service—across all seven boats, we operate at nearly a 1:1 guest-to-staff ratio.
Itineraries are typically six nights (Sunday to Sunday) and fully inclusive. This means private transfers from anywhere in France or Geneva to and from the boat, all meals prepared by your private chef, all beverages (alcoholic and non-alcoholic), daily excursions, and more- so once onboard, everything is taken care of (except for specialty excursions, which we can arrange at a supplement)

The boats generally float through Champagne, Burgundy, Provence, and Bordeaux

title: Riverside Retreat
description:
Experience Bangkok’s soulful energy by making the serene riverfront your retreat —now further enhanced with Capella Bangkok’s immersive resort offerings and complimentary nights.

Dive into the dynamic city of Bangkok, where ancient traditions meet modern wonders. At its heart, the culturally rich Charoenkrung district has been revitalised with the opening of Capella Bangkok, an elegant urban sanctuary perched on the banks of the meandering Chao Phraya River. Global travellers can now enjoy this tranquil escape with the “Riverside Retreat” offer, which includes one complimentary night and a host of other perks, when booking two consecutive nights at the Best Available Rate.Named The World’s Best Hotel and The Best Hotel in Asia in The World’s 50 Best Hotels 2024 and ranked Bangkok’s #1 Hotel in Travel + Leisure’s 2024 Luxury Awards Asia Pacific, Capella Bangkok features 101 luxurious rooms, suites, and villas with sweeping river views. Guests can choose from spacious private balconies, tropical gardens, or open-air Verandahs with cabanas and jacuzzi plunge pools. The resort boasts a Michelin-starred modern Mediterranean dining room, Côte by Mauro Colagreco; in addition to authentic Thai riverside eatery Phra Nakhon; and Stella, a bijou cocktail bar with nightly live music performances. For those seeking even deeper relaxation, Auriga Wellness, the hotel’s wellness hub, offers treatments rooted in local healing traditions and cutting-edge science.Guests can choose from a range of accommodations, starting with the residentially styled Riverfront Rooms (61 sqm), which feature floor-to-ceiling windows and a spacious balcony overlooking the lively riverfront. For those seeking even more space, the Verandah Rooms (137 sqm) offer outdoor patios complete with a sala lounge nook and jacuzzi plunge pool. The River Suite (95 sqm) boasts a separate living room, bedroom, spa-inspired bathroom, and a generous balcony fitted with divans, perfect for unwinding after a day of strolling around Bangkok’s Old Town. For ultimate luxury and privacy, the expansive Villa (259 sqm) opens onto a lush tropical garden with a private plunge pool and a large sala lounge perched right on the river’s edge.

Each stay at Capella is enhanced by the expertise of the Capella Culturists, the hotel’s clue-in cultural curators, who craft personalised itineraries tailored to each guests’ preferences. Whether guests choose to unwind at the Auriga Wellness spa, savour a sunset BBQ in their villa’s garden, or engage in inspired activities such as Muay Thai or early-morning Pilates in the riverside courtyard, Capella Culturists offer a unique, insider perspective on both the hotel and the city. They can organise walking tours through Bangkok’s vibrant café scene, private meditation sessions with the head monk of a 250-year-old temple, bicycle rides through the city’s hidden backstreets, or visits to the best local street food stalls for an authentic local experience.

title: Exclusive Access to Colosseum SUPER sites
description:
Step into history like never before with our Full Experience Colosseum Tour with Arena Floor and Exclusive SUPER Sites, granting you privileged entry to the Colosseum Archaeological Park’s rarest and most exclusive locations. This limited-time experience offers a deep dive into ancient Rome’s hidden wonders, revealing sites most visitors never get to see.
What Awaits You?
🏛 Colosseum & Arena Floor – Stand where gladiators once fought and walk through the first and second tiers of this legendary amphitheater.
🏛 Palatine Hill – Stroll through the mythical birthplace of Rome and explore the ruins of opulent imperial palaces.
🏛 Roman Forum – Wander through the heart of ancient Rome, where emperors ruled and history was made.
But the real magic lies beyond the main sites—our tour unlocks the SUPER Sites, an exclusive collection of hidden treasures that rotate based on availability. These may include:
✨ House of Augustus & House of Livia – Step inside the lavishly decorated residences of Rome’s first emperor and his wife, featuring frescoes that rival those of Pompeii.

✨ Palatine Museum – Marvel at ancient sculptures, mosaics, and artifacts housed in a monastery built over Domitian’s palace.
✨ Aula Isiaca & Loggia Mattei – Discover an Egyptian-inspired chamber from the Augustan era, alongside Renaissance villa remains.

✨ Domus Tiberiana – Explore one of Rome’s earliest imperial palaces, adorned with mosaics and sculptures.
✨ Santa Maria Antiqua – Visit a remarkably preserved 5th-century church hidden for centuries, featuring some of Rome’s oldest Christian frescoes.
✨ Curia Iulia – Step into the Roman Senate’s official meeting hall, where history-altering decisions were made.
With an expert archaeologist as your guide, you’ll gain unparalleled insights into Rome’s grandeur, from its emperors’ private quarters to hidden temples and sacred spaces lost to time.
This rare opportunity is only available for a limited time this summer. Looking for a shorter experience? Don't forget to check out our Express Colosseum Tour or our Signature Colosseum Tour!
Valid for Travel Now Through 31 Dec 2026

title: Magical Marrakech
description:
From Medinas to monuments, the Kingdom of Light is filled with extraordinary opportunities to explore, indulge and experience. We are thrilled to offer this crossroads of culture, cuisine and contemporary luxury.
How to Get there:
Delta’s seasonal non-stop Atlanta (ATL) to Marrakech (RAK) service began October 25, 2025 and offers 3x weekly service, transitioning to daily service in mid-December through early January 2026. We will service the destination through partner-air during other times of the year.†
†Flight routes subject to change without notice.
Don't miss:
• Private Roundtrip Transfers
• VIP Airport Arrival Meet and Greet• Be escorted from the plane as you arrive at Marrakech Airport. Includes:• Meeting at the Jet Bridge upon arrival
• Guidance through Security and Immigration and Customs
• Assistance at baggage claim
• Does not include transfers

• Tour: Les Hammam De Marrakech Experience• An emblematic place of relaxation for centuries, Les Hammam de Marrakech welcomes you in an authentic and intimate atmosphere. Treat yourself to a moment of relaxation in complete privacy with a signature treatment.

• Tour: Private Cooking Class at La Maison Arabe• The cooking workshops are conducted by a dada or a chef from the Moroccan restaurant, with easy-to-use modern equipment found in everyday kitchens. You will be immersed in the Moroccan culture and the culinary traditions during these very informative workshops about Moroccan ingredients, spices and the tajine cooking process.

• Tour: Private Excursion to Essaouira• You will be picked up at your hotel to depart to the wind city “Essaouira” in a 4-seater luxury minivan. The drive takes 2.5 hours and you will visit the Argan Oil Women Cooperative, a specialty of this region.

• Tour Private Hot Air Balloon Ride in Jbillat• The day will start with an early morning transfer to the area of the “Jbillates” surrounding the city. Hot Air Balloons will be waiting for you for an exclusive flight over the desert. The balloon ride will be private and transfers will be in a private car. After the 45 minute flight, enjoy a Moroccan Berber Breakfast in a village.

• Tour: Private Intimate Visit of the Medina• You will be picked up from the hotel and transferred to the heart of the old city, the Medina to start the visit of Marrakech far from tourist paths.

• Tour: Private Monuments of Marrakech City• Discover the historical part of the city by visiting its most famous monuments: Bahia Palace, a beautifully decorated palace full of enchanting inner rooms and elaborate mosaic walls.

• Tour: Private Trekking in the Atlas Mountains• The tour will depart in the morning by Jeep to reach the village of Asni where you will explore the surrounding trails. You will then continue to the village of Imlil, which is located about 40 miles from Marrakech and close to Toubkal, the highest peak in North Africa. From Imlil village, you will enjoy a wonderful day of touring and mule riding in the foothills of Mount Toubkal, the second highest peak in Africa.

Valid for Travel Now Through 25 Nov 2026

description:
Treat yourself to a longer escape with the 4th Night Free at Fairmont Sonoma Mission Inn & Spa—an iconic resort in the heart of Sonoma Wine Country.

Give yourself a longer escape with the 4th Night Free at Fairmont Sonoma Mission Inn & Spa—an iconic retreat in the heart of Sonoma Wine Country. Surrounded by natural beauty and steeped in luxury, the resort features geothermal mineral pools, elevated farm-to-table dining, and the renowned Fairmont Spa, one of the top wellness destinations in California. With the 4th night complimentary, it’s the perfect opportunity to turn that getaway into a rejuvenating four-night retreat.

There is so much more to Sonoma than wine, though that’s certainly a highlight. Fill your days with scenic hikes, vineyard bike rides, or a sunrise hot air balloon adventure. Zip line through the Redwoods for a rush of adrenaline, or head to Bodega Bay to shuck oysters and breathe in the fresh ocean air. Food lovers can enjoy hands-on cooking classes, farmers' markets, and gourmet dining that rival anything in Napa. Wander the historic Sonoma Plaza, explore local art galleries, or play a round of golf at the Sonoma Championship Golf Club - all part of a well-rounded escape that’s equal parts adventure and relaxation.

Sonoma offers all the charm and indulgence of Wine Country with a little more space to unwind. With this limited-time 4th Night Free offer, you can slow down, explore more, and truly settle into the rhythm of Wine Country living. Four nights. One unforgettable adventure.

title: Fonteverde Green Therapy Wellness Experience
location: San Casciano dei bagni, Tuscany, Italy
description:
Discover the brand new Ecotherapy Programme: 2 nights and 3 days that use the nature all around us as a therapeutic tool to improve psychological, emotional and physical wellbeing.

The serenity of the gardens and the beauty of Val d'Orcia are naturally therapeutic and join forces with the treatments of the thermal spa and its centuries-old health-giving waters to restore genuine balance.

The programme begins on the first day with Rasul, a purifying and regenerating treatment that combines mud, clay, soothing heat, steam and fragrances followed by the Thalaquam saltwater pool, where to float as if with no gravity, for a total deep relaxation.

The second day continues with our Wellbeing Awakening to start the new day in harmony with our personal trainer, followed by a session of total body Cryotherapy in the Longevity Suite that reduces stress, helps eliminate toxins and stimulates endorphins, and a Rebalance massage, to free the mind and lead you into a deep state of relaxation.

Our Wellbeing Awakening, on the third day, completes the experience to leave you feeling revitalised for your return home.

Included

• 2 Nights with breakfast at the La Corte Restaurant overlooking the sweet rolling hills of Val d'Orcia
• Thermal pools with natural hydro massage waterfall Thermal Bioaquam circuit
• Lux thermal pool, Light Bath
• Etruscan Circuit with sauna, hot plate, salt cave and Kneipp circuit Fitness room
• Rasul in Turkish bath 20’Ritual to purify and make the skin simply beautiful thanks to thermal mud and water, together with personalized clays.
• Thalaquam floating salt pool 20’: Let go of your body’s weight and rediscover absolute lightness in a deep state of peace and well-being
• Awakening wellbeing: Physical activity in the surrounding countryside together with our personal trainer
• Rebalance Massage 50’: performed with long enveloping movements to free the mind and lead you into a deep state of relaxation
• Cryotherapy Longevity Suite Total Body 4’-5’: Reduces stress, helps eliminate toxins and stimulates endorphins.

• Villa & Residence Rentals: USD 200 credit per bedroom per stay

• Villa & Residence Rentals: USD 200 credit per bedroom per stay

title: Book and Earn 2026
description:
Queridos socios,
¡Tenemos una gran oportunidad para recompensar sus ventas este verano!
Al reservar cualquiera de las propiedades participantes de la Mexico Collection en tarifa Preferred Partner, podrán acumular producción y obtener una Four Seasons e-Gift Card de USD 500.
¿Cómo participar?
✨ Reserve utilizando su Advisor ID en una tarifa Preferred Partner.
✨ Aplica únicamente para nuevas reservaciones realizadas durante el periodo promocional.
✨ Periodo de reservación y estancia: del 9 de junio al 31 de agosto de 2026.
✨ Acumule USD 20,000 en ingresos consumidos durante el periodo de la promoción. La producción puede combinarse entre todas las propiedades participantes de la Mexico Collection.
✨ Una vez alcanzada la meta, desbloqueará un Book & Earn Achievement en su perfil de ILLUME by Four Seasons.
¿Qué gana?
🎁 Una Four Seasons e-Gift Card de USD 500.
Limitada a una tarjeta por asesor por año calendario.
Aunque ya hayan obtenido su tarjeta de regalo, podrán seguir desbloqueando logros Book & Earn en ILLUME y continuar destacando su producción dentro del programa.
¿Quiénes son elegibles?
La promoción está disponible para asesores Preferred Partner elegibles ubicados en Australia, Bélgica, Brasil, Canadá, Chile, México, Arabia Saudita, Singapur, Suiza, Turquía, Emiratos Árabes Unidos, Reino Unido y Estados Unidos.
No aplica para asesores que formen parte del grupo Top Advisors 2026.
Seguimiento y entrega del premio
Los asesores podrán monitorear su progreso en tiempo real a través de su panel de ILLUME by Four Seasons durante el periodo de estancia de los huéspedes.
Una vez alcanzada la meta, recibirán una notificación por correo electrónico de illume.marketing@fourseasons.com y su e-Gift Card será enviada entre 5 y 10 días hábiles después de desbloquear su primer Book & Earn Achievement.
Esta es una excelente oportunidad para impulsar sus ventas mientras ofrecen a sus clientes experiencias excepcionales en algunos de los destinos más icónicos de México.
Si tienen clientes considerando viajar a Ciudad de México, Los Cabos, Tamarindo, Punta Mita o cualquier otra propiedad participante, estaré encantada de ayudarles a encontrar la mejor opción.
📋 Para consultar los términos, condiciones y reglas oficiales de la promoción, pueden visitar:
https://www.fourseasons.com/landing-pages/corporate/book-and-earn-2026-official-rules/
¡Mucho éxito y felices ventas!

Enjoy 20% off our Bed and Breakfast rate when you stay three or more nights.

Amenities:
- Daily full breakfast for two people per bedroom, served in a hotel restaurant or through In-Room Dining
- Hotel/Resort Credit* (based on room category booked):
• Guest Rooms: USD 100 credit per stay
• Suites and Specialty Suites: USD 200 credit per stay
• Villa & Residence Rentals: USD 200 credit per bedroom per stay
- Upgrade of one category, based on availability at time of check-in**
- Welcome note at check-in acknowledging you and your travel agency and the benefits that are being extended
- *Hotel/Resort Credit may be applied to select incidental charges incurred at the Hotel or Resort. Must be used in conjunction with the initial stay and will be applied at check-out. May not be applied towards the room rate, taxes, resort fees, service charges, conference fees, or any charges from outside vendors. Exclusions may apply; contact the Hotel/Resort for more details.
When a suite is reserved in connection with another guest room or suite, the cumulative credit (based on room category booked) value applies.
The Villa & Residence Rentals credit applies to Residences with a minimum average rate per night (before Resort fees and taxes) of USD 1,000.
**Category upgrade based on availability at time of check-in excludes Specialty Suites, Villas and the Villa & Residence Rentals collection of Villas and Residences.

Disclaimer:
All offers are subject to availability at the time of reservation. Offers are not valid in conjunction with any other offer or contract and do not apply to groups.
Rates are per room, per night, vary by arrival date and/or length of stay, and do not include applicable mandatory property fees (for example resort fees or service charges), gratuities, or government imposed taxes, service charges, levies or surcharges, unless otherwise noted.
Early departure fees may apply. Rates are subject to change. A supplemental breakfast charge may apply to children sharing a guest room with their parents or guardians.

Valid dates:
Jan 15, 2026 –Jan 10, 2028

How to Book: Check all booking tabs in Portal to see if the deal is bookable in Portal. If the promotion is not bookable in Portal, please check the hotel website or reach out to the reservations team with your client's preferred dates of stay and as much information as possible.

Experience the timeless beauty and rich history of Siena with an unbeatable promotion at the prestigious Grand Hotel Continental. For a limited time, enjoy our exclusive 3x2 special offer — stay three nights but only pay for two!

• Countryside Excursions : Explore charming towns like San Gimignano, Monteriggioni, and Montalcino, rich in history, art, and world-class wine.
• Outdoor Activities : Enjoy hiking, cycling, and horseback riding through the rolling hills and scenic landscapes surrounding Siena.

Don’t miss out on this limited-time offer to experience Siena in style at the Grand Hotel Continental. Book today and take advantage of our special 3x2 promotion

title: Gstaad Palace: 3-Bedroom Penthouse Suite
description:
Located on the very top floor of the Gstaad Palace, with 360° views stretching across the entire Saanenland and the surrounding Swiss Alps, this Penthouse Suite could be your ultimate alpine escape. With three uniquely designed bedrooms and space for up to six adults (plus children), this expansive retreat offers a true sense of belonging.

Whether it is the crackling fireplace, the blissful panoramic terrace, private elevator access, or serene spa-like features, including a hot tub and sauna – every element of this suite is thoughtfully woven together to create an experience that feels both refined and deeply authentic. Each of the three bedrooms branches off from the spacious central living room, simultaneously providing comfort, privacy, and connection to the blissful surroundings, but despite this expansive layout, the suite maintains the timeless charm and alpine character that truly define the Gstaad Palace. Complementing the fresh mountain air, individual air conditioning allows for a comfortably tailored climate throughout the suite.

To complete your stay, unwind with complimentary access to the Palace Spa and «PISCINE», or explore the village with ease thanks to our shuttle service. For the young ones between the ages of 5 and 12, Sammy’s World offers daily activities and entertainment.

Gstaad Palace: 2025 Summer Season from June 22nd to September 4th, 2025! Email reservations@palace.ch for further details and/or availability.

title: This Season, Live Florence Like a Local
description:
As the year draws to a close, Florence reveals its most enchanting side: the crisp air, the golden light, and the quiet beauty of its streets make it the perfect time for an indulgent escape.

At the Helvetia & Bristol, experience the magic of the season in the elegant heritage of the Helvetia rooms or the contemporary comfort of the Bristol suites. Begin your mornings with an unforgettable four hands breakfast, where the sweet creations of Iginio Massari meet the savory artistry of Cibrèo Caffè.

After exploring the boutiques and ateliers surrounding the hotel, unwind at LA SPA Helvetia & Bristol, home to the city’s largest wellness retreat, and immerse yourself in the ancient ritual of the Roman Baths.

Our Concierge is always ready to arrange exclusive experiences for you around the city, and since there is never enough time to discover the city like a true local, extend your stay with our special 4x3 or 3x2 offer, and make the most of these last months of the year in true Florentine style.

Complete your stay with a moment of pure relaxation at the Thermes Marins Monte-Carlo, directly connected to the hotel.  You can also enjoy exclusive access to the private beach at Monte-Carlo Beach and its wide range of seaside activities.
Just opposite the hotel, the Monte-Carlo Shopping Promenade invites you to discover more than 50 luxury boutiques, while the legendary Casino de Monte-Carlo is only a short stroll away for an unforgettable gaming experience.

title: Shark Safari Expedition
supplier: Impression Isla Mujeres by Secrets – Adults only – All Inclusive
description:
Indulge in a purpose-driven experience, luxuriously curated by Impression Isla Mujeres in partnership with the Saving Our Sharks Foundation . Discover the wonders of the sea with the Sea Masters of Isla Mujeres. Participate in responsible snorkeling experiences or contribute to vital research through Citizen Science—all in support of ocean conservation and our planet’s future.A Story of Change and Hope: Meet the Sea Masters—local experts who’ve traded fishing lines for conservation, now leading efforts to protect sharks and marine ecosystems.

Education in Motion Snorkel and observe as you learn about the delicate balance of life beneath the waves.

Tourism with a Purpose In alliance with Kab Yok Coop. , this program champions sustainability, community empowerment, and the mission of Saving Our Sharks Foundation.

- Departure at 9:00 am from the Impression Isla Mujeres Deck.

- Duration: 4 - 5 hours

- Investment: $275 USD per guest. A portion supports Kab Yok Coop. , empowering local fishermen turned marine conservationists.

Please note: While there is approximately a 90% probability of shark sightings during these experiences, encounters cannot be guaranteed. Impression Isla Mujeres, the Saving Our Sharks Foundation, and the Káb Xok cooperative operate in harmony with nature, and sightings depend on natural conditions beyond our control.

title: Complimentary immersive experience
description:
Experience Exceptionally Singapore

With a minimum of 2-night stay on applicable Virtuoso rates, enjoy a choice of one complimentary immersive experience, once per stay.

• Circuit Sidecar Adventure ( Only suitable for children aged 10 years old and above): Relive the exhilarating race action on a
vintage Vespa through a route specially designed just for our guests. Zip
through the Marina Bay Street track and take in the sights of the unique
landmarks in Singapore including the F1 Pit Building that was first built to
host the world’s first night race, photo stop at Anderson bridge and drive by
the iconic Merlion.
• Heritage River Cruise : Hop
on a bumboat of yesteryear and cruise down memory lane along Clarke Quay, Boat
Quay and Marina Bay as you discover the stories of Singapore’s bustling trading
ports whilst basking in the sights and sounds of the city.
• Trail of Singapore’s Garden Oasis ( Flower Dome & Cloud Forest ): Bask
in the wonders of nature at Gardens by the Bay, a 101-hectare waterfront garden
sanctuary. Step into a whimsical world of floral displays at the Flower Dome,
the world's largest glass greenhouse, or discover exotic plant species at the
Cloud Forest, a space home to one of the world's tallest indoor waterfalls.
• Beyond the Singapore Horizon ( Singapore Flyer ): Take a sky-high ride on the Singapore Flyer,
Asia's largest observation wheel standing 165 meters aboveground, and marvel at
the breathtaking views of city skyline aboard the glass capsules. Elevate the
experience with a multi-sensory adventure into Singapore’s past, present and
future at the Time Capsule.
• A Voyage through Singapore’s Story ( National Museum ): Delve into an immersive narrative of Singapore at the National Museum of Singapore, the nation’s oldest museum housed in a neoclassical building. Uncover the stories of the lion city through a collection of artefacts and discover Singapore’s development from ancient settlement to modern city at the Singapore History Gallery.

Terms

• Combinable with standard Virtuoso benefits and amenities.
• Advanced booking recommended.
• Do note that these experiences are subject to availability, and operating hours may vary due to operating and maintenance schedules of attractions, and weather conditions (terms and conditions and blackout dates may apply).

title: Virtuoso Sustainability Preferred Partner
description:
?? SUSTAINABILITY IS OUR WAY OF LIFE at Morgan’s Rock Hacienda & Ecolodge ??

Nestled within 1,000 hectares of private nature reserve and reforestation land on Nicaragua’s Pacific coast, Morgan’s Rock is more than a luxury eco-lodge it’s a living example of how tourism and nature can thrive in harmony.

? What makes us truly sustainable?

? Conservation-first design Our bungalows are built using responsibly sourced tropical wood and volcanic stone. With Evening Breeze Beds , guests enjoy comfort while minimizing energy use.

? A working farm-to-table model Over 60% of the food served at our restaurant is grown on-site from vegetables and eggs to sustainably farmed shrimp.

? Local impact We employ team members from nearby communities, supporting economic development and cultural exchange.

? Reforestation and biodiversity We are home to howler monkeys, sloths, white-tipped deer, and nesting sea turtles all protected within our reserve.

? Eco-conscious experiences From kayaking and hiking to yoga and horseback riding, every experience connects guests to nature in a mindful way.

?? Proud to be a Virtuoso Sustainability Preferred Partner. Because travel should give back to the planet, to the people, and to future generations.

?? Morgan’s Rock Hacienda & Ecolodge naturally luxurious, ethically unforgettable.

title: Bayeux Tapestry
description:
Bayeux Tapestry
A stay curated for history and craft lovers with tickets to see the Bayeux Tapestry at the British Museum.

The greatest story ever stitched, back on English soil for the first time in nearly a millennium.
Just a short stroll through Covent Garden and Bloomsbury brings you to the British Museum, our official partner for this landmark season. Here, one of the most anticipated cultural events of our lifetime unfolds: the Bayeux Tapestry on view, a loan from France in a historic, once-in-a-generation agreement.

Across 70 metres, 58 scenes and more than 600 embroidered figures, the Bayeux Tapestry tells the story of the Norman Conquest – the last successful invasion of England and one of history’s greatest tales. Displayed flat in one continuous length for the first time, this is the tapestry as it has never been seen before, and a moment unlikely to come again.

Experience the story with an overnight stay, exhibition tickets for two and a cocktail in the Lobby Bar inspired by the threads of the tale.

What’s Included?
Overnight stay for two
Two tickets to The Bayeux Tapestry at the British Museum
A themed cocktail each

title: Book your Orient Express Journey in Italy!
description:
Orient Express Palazzo Donà Giovannelli: opening in April 2026, it is the next upcoming hotel of the legendary brand following the opening of Orient Express La Minerva in Rome. The property invites travellers into a world where the splendour of Venice and the spirit of travel converge.
In the heart of Cannaregio, the first Venetian district where the life of La Serenissima remains untouched, Orient Express Palazzo Donà Giovannelli occupies a singular position at the confluence of two canals, in a noble residence built in 1436 under the reign of master architect Filippo Calendario, the visionary behind the Doge’s Palace. Architect and interior designer Aline Asmar d’Amman has masterfully orchestrated a multilayered restoration, where theatrical grandeur meets luminous poetry. From original frescoes by great Italian masters to mosaic floors, every patina, every detail was revived with reverence to rekindle Palazzo Dona Giovannelli’s enduring legacy.
Palazzo Donà Giovannelli offers 47 guestrooms, suites and apartments, where heritage meets contemporary design in a timeless setting, evocative of the finest venetian lifestyle.
Six Signature Suites, located on the Piano Nobile and first floor, reflect the distinctive grandeur of the Serenissima’s art of living with tailored spaces of unique character, while the first-ever Orient Express Apartments housed in an adjacent building offer a residential vibrancy with reinterpreted modernity and outstanding canal views. The hotel’s culinary offering includes an intimate fine dining restaurant with private boat access, an all-day dining space overlooking the lively courtyard and lush garden, a rarity in Venice, and the iconic Wagon Bar – a nod to the golden age of rail travel.
Book now your entire Orient Express Journey in Italy ! Start your experience in Rome at the Orient Express La Minerva, onboard on La Dolce Vita train for a one way trip from Rome to Venice and be welcomed at Palazzo Donà Giovannelli for your memorable stay!

title: PONANT EXPLORATIONS and The Explorers Club Voyages
description:
Discover Your Inner Explorer.
For over 35 years, PONANT EXPLORATIONS has been taking
guests to some of the planet’s most remote, hidden, and untouched
locations—places where nature reigns supreme. This choice carries a
responsibility to protect the ecosystems that define these places and the
communities that inhabit them. To remain at the forefront of innovation, the
company works daily to promote a more responsible and sustainable form of
tourism. As part of this commitment, PONANT EXPLORATIONS is aiming to launch
the first zero-emission ocean-going cruise ship by 2030.
This pioneering spirit also fuels PONANT EXPLORATIONS' alliance with The Explorers Club, offering a truly unique experience of research and exploration. On select voyages to some of the world’s most distant corners, the PONANT ships host an esteemed speaker from The Explorers Club—as well Explorers Club Science Grantees —to enhance your journey and support scientific discovery.
Each voyage features an exciting onboard lecture series hosted by an esteemed member of The Explorers Club. Guests enjoy tales of exploration, learn about scientific research, and attend insightful talks, all providing deeper context for the surroundings and journey.
The Explorers Club Science Grantees are onboard select voyages aboard Le Commandant Charcot, utilizing its dedicated laboratories and sharing firsthand insights of their ongoing research.
About The Explorers Club
Since its 1904 founding by the world’s leading explorers of the time, The Explorers Club and its members have achieved many such illustrious milestones: first to the North Pole, first to the South Pole, first to Everest’s summit, the deep ocean floor, the moon’s surface, and more. Explorers linked to the greatest discoveries, such as Neil Armstrong, Jane Goodall, Edmund Hillary, or Roald Amundsen, are among its eminent members.

title: Le Commandant Charcot: The World’s Only Luxury Icebreaker
description:
Book with your Virtuoso Travel Advisor and receive an exclusive $200 shipboard credit per stateroom or suite, in addition to up to 30% PONANT Bonus Savings.
5 Exclusive Experiences aboard Le Commandant Charcot
1
REACHING THE UNREACHABLE

Embark on an odyssey beyond the Antarctic Peninsula and stake your claim as
one of the only visitors to the region in early November. You’ll observe wildlife
including blue, fin, humpback, and minke whales as they migrate south and
navigate the ice floes, along with Adélie, chinstrap, gentoo, and maybe even
emperor penguins. Or head north and visit the Inuit villages of Greenland as
early as May, several weeks before any other ship. Stay in the Arctic in winter and
enjoy the magic of the Northern Lights.
2 THE WORLD’S FIRST AND ONLY EXTREME POLAR EXPLORATION VESSEL
To start, a bit of background: Polar Class (PC) refers to a ship’s ability to navigate
and break through ice throughout the year. On a scale of 1–7, PC1 ships offer year-round operations in all polar waters; PC7 ships are able to cruise through first-year ice in the summer and autumnal months only. Le Commandant Charcot, the
only passenger ship in the world with a PC2 classified hull, is able to navigate
through multiyear ice, often between 6 and 13 feet thick .
3 LEADING EXPERTS BY YOUR SIDE
For the past 35 years, PONANT EXPLORATIONS has been creating trips to
isolated destinations, guided by nature and a desire to promote cultural
enrichment. When on board Le Commandant Charcot, this translates into a team
of approximately 20 nature guides, offering guests an unmatched ratio on our
expeditions. This also means officers on board are given extensive training to
skilfully navigate the ice.
4 A TRUE, ONCE-IN-A-LIFETIME IMMERSION INTO THE POLAR EXPERIENCE
To really connect with the natural world, join an optional excursion on our
expeditions to Greenland, and spend two days and one night off the ship, camping
in the heart of the ice, in the company of Inuit guides. Other activities include the
chance to board kayaks from a patch of pack ice; get your heart racing on a dogsled ride through a breathtaking landscape; and visit traditional villages in the
middle of winter, or the very start of spring. These experiences open the doors to
an authentic and spectacular setting, well beyond the limits of your imagination.
5 INSIDE/OUTSIDE: THE INVISIBLE FRONTIER
The perfect vantage points to admire the stunning scenery, the ship’s communal
areas were designed by world-renowned architects Jean-Philippe Nuel and Jean Michel Wilmotte, and offer a cozy cocoon in even the most extreme environments.
Created to let the outside in, Le Commandant Charcot features unique spaces
that set her apart from the rest of our fleet, such as the Blue Lagoon, an open-air
lagoon heated using recovered energy; indoor swimming pool; snow cabin; detox
bar within the spa; and Cigar Lounge.
Valid for Travel Now Through 31 Dec 2027

title: An afternoon in the Sassi: Guided tour of Matera with wine tasting
description:
Discover the timeless beauty of Matera, a UNESCO World Heritage site located approximately 40 minutes from Palazzo Margherita. Carved into the rock, the ancient Sassi districts offer one of the most extraordinary landscapes in the Mediterranean and an authentic glimpse into centuries of history. The experience begins with a visit to the Crypt of the Original Sin, often referred to as the “Sistine Chapel of Rupestrian Art,” an extraordinary rock-cut cave dating back to the 8th century and adorned with evocative frescoes from the Old and New Testaments. Continue with a guided exploration of the historic Sassi of Matera, where winding alleys, ancient dwellings, and breathtaking viewpoints reveal the city’s unique character. The evening concludes with a guided wine tasting led by an expert sommelier, offering the chance to explore the rich flavoures of Lucanian wines. This immersive experience takes on a journey through the region’s vineyards and traditions, accompanied by carefully selected local delicacies.

title: Guided tour of Taranto through the two seas:
description:
The historic city of Taranto, often referred to as the “City of the Two Seas,” is one of Southern Italy’s most ancient and fascinating destinations. Founded by Spartan colonists in the 8th century BC, it played a key role in the history of Magna Graecia and later became an important Roman naval base. Its unique geography — between the Mar Grande and the Mar Piccolo — has shaped the city’s culture and identity for centuries. Today, visitors can discover a captivating blend of Greek, Roman, medieval, and baroque heritage, especially in the atmospheric old town, set on a small island and characterized by narrow streets, noble palaces, ancient churches, and beautiful sea views. A guided exploration, complemented by a scenic boat excursion and followed by a traditional Apulian lunch, offers a unique perspective on Taranto’s rich history and coastal landscape.

title: Space out with the Parker
description:
Located far away from artificial lights and atmospheric pollutants, Joshua Tree is one of the world’s 117 International Dark Sky Parks. Summer is especially prime for stargazing; the “core” of the Milky Way is visible most nights from 10 p.m. to sunrise. 

New this season, Parker Palm Springs has launched an offer for guests to take advantage of the region’s spectacular night skies. “Space Out with the Parker” (from $5,571) includes a three-night stay in a one-bedroom villa with a living room, dining area, and a private hedgerow enclosed patio. Guests who book the package will also enjoy a Spotify mix of songs culled from the NASA Wake-up Call soundtrack; a two-hour, private stargazing experience by Sky Watcher Sky Tours; the use of a kit complete with a red flashlight, portable telescope, and an iPad with SkyView star locator map; a celestial-themed picnic with treats like moon pies and galaxy star cookies; and a bottle of Dom Perignon Champagne (the French winemaker once famously said, “Come quickly, I am drinking the stars”).

Valid thru 12/31/26
3-night minimum stay required
Guests must book two weeks in advance

The South Pacific is a dream destination—and aboard the m/s Paul Gauguin it’s also a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for your family to strengthen bonds and create memories you’ll cherish forever through our Moana Explorer program.
Offered in partnership with Te mana o te moana, a South Pacific marine education and conservation foundation, this one-of-a-kind program invites children and teens, ages 6-15, to discover and value the natural wonders of this breathtaking part of the world through hands-on, interactive learning.
Every day of the voyage, there is a combination of naturalist-led island and/or beach excursions, science activities, crafts, games, and other adventures. Depending on their itinerary, your children might learn about underwater life through board games, create natural jewelry, conduct water experiments, go on a treasure hunt, enjoy water games in the onboard pool, go stargazing, design their own Polynesian tattoo, and more. Choose 2 of your favorite cities among Florence, Milan, Rome and create your long-awaited Italian duet experience.
Unwind with conspicuously Milanese aperitivo while lounging in the sophisticated spaces of Portrait Milano. Or say A presto! to the sun disappearing behind Ponte Vecchio from your River view suite at the Portrait Firenze.
Or enjoy Dolce Vita – leaning moments over the 360° view rooftop terrace at the Portrait Roma.
Our Lifestyle teams will tailor your dream-come-true stay. With the sartorial attitude that distinguish Portrait Collection, we will arrange the most amazing experiences with personally handpicked local partners. These beauties await you… Do not keep them waiting!
The Italian duet in details:
• A minimum stay of 5 nights in total to be spend in 2 Portrait hotels within 2 weeks (Portrait Roma | Portrait Firenze | Portrait Milano)

Not combinable with Virtuoso Amenities

title: Celebrating 100 Years of Art Deco
supplier: Prince de Galles, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Paris
description: Unlocking Art Deco: Three-hour expert-guided museum and shopping tour Inspired by the original Art Deco features of the hotel you are invited on a journey to explore the iconic Art Deco landmarks and hidden gems in the city where this revered style was born. Four years after the 1925 Paris Exposition Internationale des Arts Décoratifs - that gave the Art Deco style its name - Prince de Galles a Luxury Collection Hotel Paris was built in that same classic style by celebrated jazz-age architect André Arfvidson and has been championing grace and exceptional comfort since 1929. In the company of an Art Deco expert guide discover a curated selection of Art Deco treasures which includes masterworks such as the revolutionary Théâtre des Champs-Élysées-Paris's first Art Deco building-and showpieces such as the Musée des Arts Décoratifs where an entire Art Deco gallery features fascinating period rooms with their own stories to tell. Unlocking the Art Deco Suite programme includes: One night's stay for two persons in a Suite Daily à la carte breakfast Three hour expert-guided museam and shopping tour: Théâtre des Champs-Élysées - exclusive access Musée d'Art Moderne de Paris Palais d'Iéna Musée des Arts Décoratifs & catalogue Printemps Restrictions: The offer can be booked online. Offer is subject to availability. Booking Unlocking Art Deco requires five days' advance notice. Sotheby's expert visit Printemps VIP personal shopping and Palais de la Porte Dorée are optional. title: A Taste of Puglian Summer
description:
Puglia in summer is a gentle reminder to embrace life’s slower rhythms and discover culinary experiences that offer a unique sense of connection to this extraordinary region. Our peaceful masseria – the ideal summer destination for food lovers – celebrates Southern Italy’s time-honoured gastronomic traditions and rich flavours.
Spend mindful days unwinding amidst lush gardens, riding a bicycle through our sun-drenched olive groves, or drifting between the wisteria-lined pool and the cool of your serene, white-washed room. Linger over rustic yet exquisite cuisine with two lunches at our relaxed Violetta by the pool, or dinners at Carosello, our elegant restaurant whose menus by Chef Fulvio Pierangelini showcase Italy’s best flavours.
During your stay with us, venture beyond the masseria to our nearby partner restaurants, serving seasonal dishes from the locally produced cheese to regional icons such as handmade orecchiette. An exclusive opportunity to experience Puglia’s bountiful terroir and heritage amid charming surroundings that invite an unhurried, summer state of mind.

title: The magic of solo travel on luxury windjammers
description:
There is something truly liberating about travelling on your own - putting yourself first, savouring serenity, and exploring entirely at your own pace. In 2026, we invite you to elevate that experience aboard our legendary tall ships with nine specially selected voyages, offering exclusive savings for solo travellers. For these sailings, we waive the single surcharge in Categories E (Deluxe Stateroom) and B (Junior Suite) on SEA CLOUD II as well as Categories D (Deluxe Stateroom) and B (Junior Veranda Suite) on SEA CLOUD SPIRIT.
 Trade winter’s chills for the tropical breeze of the Caribbean or bask in the summer sun of Europe’s most enchanting destinations.
 Picture yourself gliding by Zodiac to secluded bays surrounded by lush greenery, enjoying barefoot barbecues on the beach, floating in stunning grottoes, or snorkelling in crystalline waters – that’s the essence of the Caribbean aboard the SEA CLOUDs.
 Or perhaps Europe calls to you: explore the diverse nature of the Canary Islands, uncover the rich history of the Greek Isles, delight in Italy’s irresistible cuisine, or mingle with the luxury yachting community on the French Riviera.
    Your perfect solo sailing adventure awaits! Contact your Virtuoso travel advisor today and let SEA CLOUD CRUISES take you there.Valid for Travel Now Through 15 Dec 2026

title: Embrace the Pura Vida lifestyle with early booking discounts
description:
Breathtaking natural beauty, exotic beaches, vibrant cultures, and mouthwatering cuisine – welcome to the wonders of Central America! Step aboard and sail off the beaten path, from the stunning ABC Islands along the coasts of Colombia and Panama, to the wild Pacific shores of Costa Rica, or northward past Honduras and Belize all the way to Mexico.
Swim in the crystal-clear waters of Curaçao, uncover UNESCO World Heritage treasures in the colonial city of Cartagena, marvel at the engineering feat of the Panama Canal, or walk in the footsteps of the ancient Maya at the Lamanai ruins. These are just a few of the unforgettable experiences that await you on our cruises through one of the world’s most diverse and thrilling regions.
Can’t choose just one itinerary?
Our 21-day sailings combine two extraordinary routes into the ultimate Central American adventure. Highlights include Aruba, Bonaire, Panama’s San Blas and Pearl Islands, Punta Leona and Puerto Quepos in Costa Rica – and so much more.
Whether you’re a spontaneous traveller or a long-term planner, we’ve got you covered. Identical voyages are available in both 2026 and 2027, so you can either sail away soon or savor the excitement as your dream trip approaches.
And here’s the best part:
Enjoy early booking discounts – book by 31 August 2025 for 2026 sailings, or by 30 June 2026 for 2027 voyages.
Contact your Virtuoso travel advisor today for rates and availability. Your Central American adventure awaits!
Valid for Travel  09 Feb 2026 - 25 Mar 2027

description:
Enjoy more days at sea and take in the stunning beauty of the Caribbean and Central America with Star Clippers' extended voyages.
For a limited time, when you book select sailings, you'll receive an extra bonus of $500 in Air Credits per cabin PLUS prepaid gratuities.
In the Caribbean, discover Basseterre's charming pastel waterfront, the French-Caribbean allure of Terre-de-Haut, or Bequia's sparkling shores. These longer itineraries give you the chance to explore more islands, from the peaceful bays of Martinique to the lively harbors of St. Lucia, offering a richer and more immersive experience of the region.
In Central America, explore Balboa's historic piers, sail through the incredible Panama Canal, visit the pristine islands of the San Blas Archipelago, and enjoy the vibrant streets of Cartagena and Santa Marta. Each stop offers a unique glimpse into the region's diverse landscapes, from tropical forests and rugged volcanic coastlines to lively seaside towns.
With more destinations, extra days under sail, and added savings on select departures, these longer journeys are the perfect way to experience the Caribbean and Central America in style.

title: SIGNATURE SUITES OFFER
description: Indulge in our signature Suites. Unlock exclusive cultural experiences from music to art and more SIGNATURE SUITES OFFER From original historical frescoes to exclusive partnerships with the Wiener Symphoniker the Albertina Museum and the Belvedere Palace each signature suite offers a journey that celebrates Vienna's music art and architecture: THE RITZ-CARLTON SYMPHONY SUITE (one bedroom suite) As a tribute to Vienna's rich musical heritage The Ritz-Carlton Symphony Suite has created an exclusive partnership with the Wiener Symphoniker the esteemed and globally renowned orchestra to welcome guests to a residence adorned with exquisite and luxurious furnishings. Experience an exclusive VIP visit to the Vienna Symphony Orchestra's general rehearsals a privilege reserved solely for guests staying in The Ritz-Carlton Symphony Suite. Unlike regular tickets this opportunity is extended only to those indulging in this suite. Additionally savor wine crafted exclusively for the guests ensuring a unique sensory experience. THE RITZ-CARLTON ALBERTINA SUITE (two bedrooms suite) Immerse yourself in The Ritz-Carlton Albertina Suite where the exclusive "Batliner" collection transforms your retreat into a private art gallery featuring masterpieces by Marc Chagall Emil Nolde Edgar Degas and Claude Monet. As a guest of The Ritz-Carlton Albertina Suite you're not just booking a suite; you're securing a VIP experience at the Albertina Museum. Immerse yourself in Central Europe's largest collection of modern art featuring exhibitions from Monet to Picasso. PRESIDENTIAL SUITE (two bedrooms suite) Situated within the former Palais Gutmann named after the rags-to-riches family who once owned it the suite still preserves an original masterpiece by August Eisenmenger. Adorning the area around the living room chandelier the ceiling from the former Belletage depicts twelve months represented by angels. Eisenmenger also painted the famous Golden Hall ceiling fresco of the Vienna Musikverein. Embark on a journey to uncover Vienna's hidden gems with our exclusive private tour led by local expert guides. title: Honeymoon
description:
Celebrate the beginning of a lifetime together with a journey that captures the essence of Chile—where untamed Patagonia meets the sophistication of world-class wine country.This thoughtfully curated six-night honeymoon experience begins at The Singular Patagonia, a remarkable property set within a restored historic building overlooking the fjords of Puerto Bories. Here, couples immerse themselves in the raw beauty of southern Chile, with daily guided excursions exploring Torres del Paine National Park, the landscapes of Puerto Natales, and the hidden corners of Patagonia. Evenings are defined by refined gastronomy, while moments of relaxation include a hydrotherapy experience and spa treatments designed for two. The journey continues in striking contrast at VIK Chile, located in the Millahue Valley—“Place of Gold”—one of South America’s most celebrated wine regions. Surrounded by vineyards and avant-garde architecture, this is where romance meets the art of winemaking. Days unfold at a slower rhythm, with private vineyard explorations, guided tastings—including exclusive access to the barrel room—and immersive experiences that connect guests to the land, from garden tastings of native ingredients to horseback rides through the vines. At the heart of the VIK experience is wine: each meal is thoughtfully paired, from leisurely lunches with curated selections to elegant four-course dinners accompanied by premium wines that reflect the terroir of the valley. A welcome bottle of wine in-suite sets the tone, inviting couples to savour each moment together. The program also includes a complimentary night at The Singular Santiago, offering a seamless transition and a final urban touch to an otherwise nature-driven journey.Highlights include:

3 nights in Patagonia with all meals and daily excursions


2 nights at VIK Chile with immersive wine and culinary experiences


Vineyard and winery tours with tastings, including barrel room access


Spa experiences for two in Patagonia


Complimentary night in Santiago to complete the journey

From the dramatic wilderness of Patagonia to the elegance of Chile’s wine valleys, this is a honeymoon designed to be both deeply enriching and effortlessly romantic.Valid for Travel Now Through 23 Apr 2027

description: Embrace an extended stay in luxury. Stay 3 nights in a premium suite and save 20% Relinquish your routine and embrace an extended stay in luxury. Stay three nights in either our Heritage Studio Suite Heritage Suite Pavilion Suite St David's Suite or Aurora Suite and save 20% off the retail rate. At The Tasman each of our premium suites is a page in the hotel's rich architectural story which spans from the 1840s to the present day. The Heritage Suites showcase original Georgian details including vaulted doors and restored fireplaces in some rooms. St. David's Park suite is the crown jewel of the hotel's Georgian heritage building. The space exudes warmth and grandeur owing to its heritage fireplace exposed sandstone walls and original local artwork. The modern Pavilion Suites frame waterfront views with floor-to-ceiling windows. These two corner suites honour the city's maritime history with views and design that reflect it. Expansive windows look out across the Hobart waterfront and River Derwent and an elegant palette of blues and greys is complemented by original artworks. The Aurora Suite is the pinnacle of modern luxury. The 108-square-meter rooftop suite's most striking features include uninterrupted views of the waterfront and Derwent Harbour; an expansive outdoor terrace ideal for entertaining with a sandstone-and-glass firepit; and a spacious bathroom with a freestanding soaking tub. title: $25 off tickets for a guided sightseeing tour of South LA and Crenshaw
description:
This signature Black history experience explores the cultural core of South Los Angeles and offers an engaging, accessible introduction to Black LA history, entrepreneurship, architecture, and community life. The tour is primarily a guided driving experience through the Crenshaw corridor and surrounding neighborhoods, with curated stops that allow you to step out, walk, and fully experience the environment — including time in Leimert Park Village, the historic arts and cultural heart of Black Los Angeles.

Along the way, you will encounter iconic murals and public art, architecturally significant homes, legacy businesses, and cultural landmarks that have shaped the identity of the city. Through layered storytelling and historical context, the experience connects past and present — illuminating the people, movements, and everyday visionaries who continue to define the heartbeat of Black Los Angeles.

Lunch is included as part of the cultural experience. Rather than a standard meal stop, guests enjoy food from respected, independently owned establishments that reflect the culinary legacy and entrepreneurial spirit of the corridor.

title: An Invitation to Savour
description: Villa La Massa reveals itself as an experience to be embraced with ease and freedom, nestled in the Florentine countryside just minutes from the city centre and accompanied by the gentle flow of the Arno, where gastronomy becomes an integral part of the journey.The An Invitation to Savour package includes breakfast overlooking the Arno and a lunch or dinner at the estate’s restaurants, with the option to enjoy lunch at L’Oliveto or dinner at Il Verrocchio, freely selecting three courses from the à la carte menu, beverages excluded.Available throughout the entire season with no minimum stay requirement, the offer ensures complete flexibility both in the length of stay and in planning the culinary experience. An invitation to experience time at your own pace, without preset schemes.This proposal is ideal for those seeking a refined yet spontaneous stay, where hospitality is tailored around the guest’s desires. A perfect balance of comfort and culinary pleasure, in the authentic heart of the Florentine countryside.Valid for Travel Now Through 14 Nov 2026

title: Florence Escape 25%
description: Experience a different rhythm of travel with an exclusive stay at Villa La Massa, where the intimacy of a historic residence meets the natural beauty of life by the Arno.Set along the river and surrounded by iris gardens and rolling landscapes, the Villa offers a serene and refined atmosphere, designed for those seeking time to slow down and reconnect. Here, each moment unfolds naturally, from quiet mornings immersed in nature to afternoons spent between the gardens and the river, in a setting that feels both private and timeless.Life at Villa La Massa is defined by a sense of effortless elegance, where every space invites relaxation and discovery. Whether enjoying the tranquillity of the Villa or lingering over seasonal cuisine inspired by the surroundings, the experience is shaped by simplicity and a deep connection to place.While immersed in this peaceful setting, guests can easily explore Florence, located just a short distance away and conveniently connected via the hotel’s shuttle service. The city’s art, culture and vibrant atmosphere become a natural extension of the stay, offering a harmonious balance between retreat and exploration.With 25% savings on your stay, this is an invitation to embrace a more authentic and refined way of travelling, where nature and understated elegance come together in perfect harmony.Valid for Travel Now Through 14 Nov 2026

title: Yacht Honeymoon
location: Bhutan, India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Argentina, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Botswana, Kenya, Mauritius, Mozambique, Namibia, Rwanda, Seychelles, South Africa, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia, Zanzibar, Zimbabwe
description:
Sail across crystal-clear waters, surrounded by breathtaking views
Your honeymoon should be an unforgettable experience, and what’s more unforgettable than exploring one of the earth’s most iconic destination: the Galapagos Islands and Peruvian Amazon.
In the Galapagos, walk hand in hand along pristine beaches, snorkel with playful sea lions, and marvel at the unique wildlife that inspired Darwin’s theory of evolution. Or choose to venture deep into the heart of the Peruvian Amazon, where you’ll cruise through lush rainforests, spot exotic wildlife, and experience the magic of remote river villages. Aboard either of our luxury expedition yachts, the &Beyond Galapagos Explorer or Amazon Explorer, get ready to indulge in world-class service, savour gourmet cuisine prepared by expert chefs and relax in elegant accommodations with panoramic views of nature’s wonders.
This exclusive offer includes a 50% saving on you OR your partner’s luxurious accommodation aboard the &Beyond Galapagos Explorer or Amazon Explorer; valid for 6 months after the marriage date.
With exclusive excursions led by expert guides, you’ll uncover the hidden treasures of these breathtaking destinations while enjoying the privacy and comfort of our luxurious yachts. From mesmerising sunsets over the ocean to thrilling riverside wildlife encounters, your honeymoon will be a once-in-a-lifetime experience—one that you’ll cherish forever.
This offer is applicable from between 29 September and 20 December 2026.
